Ringtone Maker

Trim any audio file into a ringtone with fade in/out — preview it, then download as WAV or MP3.

WAV export always works. MP3 needs the lamejs encoder from the CDN. Everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose an audio file.
  2. Drag the start/end sliders to the section you want.
  3. Set fade-in and fade-out lengths.
  4. Preview, then download as WAV or MP3.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do trimming and fades work?

Set start/end times and fade lengths, then preview before downloading. Fades are linear volume ramps applied to the real audio data.

WAV or MP3 — which should I pick?

WAV always works (built into your browser). MP3 needs the encoder library to load from the CDN — if it fails you'll get an honest message.

Is my audio uploaded?

Yes — decoding, trimming and encoding all happen locally in your browser.
